name: Mississippi
sources: MS DOR, Individual Income Tax General Information (dor.ms.gov/general-information): 0% on the first $10,000 of taxable income, exemptions, standard deductions, each spouse taxed separately
MS H.B. 1 (2025 Reg. Sess.), via EY Tax News 2025-0936: 4.00% rate for tax year 2026
MS DOR Form 80-108 (2023): itemized deductions follow federal Schedule A, medical above 7.5% of AGI, state income tax removed, no requirement to itemize federally
notes: Mississippi taxes each spouse separately; joint returns assume each spouse has at least $10,000 of taxable income.
